scope: Primary mathematical reference identities for the finite scalar-response benchmark; measure and error derivations are given explicitly in response.md

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions: Modified Bessel integral representation 10.32.2
sources.reading_depth: Read displayed equation 10.32.2 and its Re(nu)>-1/2 condition
sources.supports: Identification Z(kappa)=2 I_1(kappa)/kappa from the normalized semicircle/Haar integral
sources.limitations: A special-function identity, not a Yang-Mills continuum or gap result

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions: Modified Bessel recurrences and derivatives 10.29.2
sources.supports: Logarithmic derivative of I_1/kappa gives I_2/I_1; recurrence signs for the K branch must use its appropriate convention
sources.limitations: Does not justify choosing an arbitrary Riccati integration constant as a probability measure

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions: Modified Bessel equation and standard solutions
sources.reading_depth: Read equation 10.25.1, defining series 10.25.2 and standard solution definitions
sources.supports: Linearized scalar response equation reduces to the order-one modified Bessel equation
sources.limitations: A local ODE solution requires a nonzero denominator and the regular branch to represent the compact measure

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions: Small-argument limiting forms
sources.reading_depth: Read 10.30.1 and 10.30.2 at fixed positive order
sources.supports: K_1(kappa) ~ 1/kappa and K_2(kappa) ~ 2/kappa^2 imply inadmissible branch u ~ -2/kappa
sources.limitations: Asymptotic forms are not finite-argument interval error bounds
